notes.title: Version 0.3 - Handful of Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Version 0.3 fixes a few bugs
[olist]
[*] Shift + Right Click was not working in builds. This was only an issue in levels 36-37
[*]Connecting a lever to another lever should no longer crash the game.
[*]If the game offers to let you skip a level and you don't skip, you will have to make 5 more attempts before being offered to skip again.
[/olist]

notes.title: Now with 40 Levels to Play!
notes.content:
Levels 37-40 have been added to GG with version 0.29!! 

With this version, GG will also move out of Early Access. So that's exciting! Major bugs that are reported will be fixed, but GG will move into a maintenance phase moving forward.

notes.title: Grub Gauntlet - Demo!!!
notes.content:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1446560/Grub_Gauntlet/]Grub Gauntlet Demo[/url] is here! Play the first 10 levels for free and build your own custom levels with the level designer - workshop functionality will ship with the full version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39228404/cfbdf3be72f2a2ba1e2e3cb3a388ec55b9ea6534.png[/img]

notes.title: New Name: Grub Gauntlet
notes.content:
With some minor soul searching and good advice, there is a new name in town --> Grub Gauntlet

The name is a bit more fun, a bit less random, and it does a better job of describing or creating a picture of what the game is all about. 

Also! There is a free demo version in the works. It'll contain the first 10 levels (all reworked), the sandbox scene with the capability to save and load - but no workshop functionality. The demo should be released sometime in September and is in testing now. ;)
